risks.risk: Valve may be old/worn rather than new as claimed, affecting safety and resale value.

risks.proof: Service/inspection report or weight check against standard tare weight.

proof_requests: Close-up of the manufacture/test date stamp on the cylinder collar.
Video of a soapy-water leak test on the valve and seams.
Close-up of the valve showing any manufacture markings or new-part packaging/receipt.
Photo of the cylinder on a scale showing tare weight (for corrosion/wall-thickness check).
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or document does not change what is visible; the cylinder is identifiable but the tested/no-leak/new-valve claims remain unverified, so it is still priced at worst case pending real proof.
